description: Redaction vectors for the reference redactors' default patterns (Agent Capability Standard 1.2.0, section 6.7): grounded_agency/state/redaction.py and packages/acs-core/src/redact.ts. Informative: the Standard defines what a secret is and that it is replaced by the marker [REDACTED]; these vectors pin what the two reference redactors recognise, so they agree. Each vector redacts `input` (a string or a JSON value) with `secret_values` registered: `expect.output` is the redacted value and `expect.pointers` the JSON Pointers (RFC 6901) of the members changed, in document order ("" when the input is a string that changed). A vector with `anchor: true` redacts `input` as an evidence anchor (section 6.5) as an evidence store or a trace keeps it (`Redactor.redact_anchor`, `redactAnchor`): `expect.output` is the anchor kept, and `expect.pointers` are still those of the input read as a JSON value. An anchor that held a secret keeps no digest of what it cites: its `digest` and `metadata.hash` go, and its `metadata` says `digest_omitted: "secret"` (section 6.7: a digest of content that may be no more than a secret could be inverted by guessing).

vectors.name: bearer_header
vectors.about: An Authorization header's value, after its scheme.

vectors.name: authorization_basic
vectors.about: A Basic Authorization header; the scheme stays.

vectors.name: bearer_in_text
vectors.about: A Bearer token outside a header.
vectors.input: retry with Bearer abcdefgh12345678 if it fails

expect.output: retry with Bearer [REDACTED] if it fails

vectors.name: url_userinfo
vectors.about: The password of a URL's userinfo; the user and host stay.

vectors.name: url_userinfo_scheme_in_a_word
vectors.about: A URL's scheme is a run of scheme characters that holds a letter, wherever the run starts: the password is redacted after `_` too.

vectors.name: query_token
vectors.about: A credential in a query string; the other parameters stay.

vectors.name: password_assignment
vectors.about: An assignment to a name that ends in a credential name.

vectors.name: json_text_token
vectors.about: A credential member in JSON text.

vectors.name: api_key_json_member
vectors.about: A string member whose name is a credential name is redacted whole.

vectors.name: structured_headers
vectors.about: Headers as JSON members: the Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie values are redacted whole, as their text form is; other headers stay.

vectors.name: camel_case_members
vectors.about: A member name that ends in a credential name after any prefix, camelCase included, is redacted whole; a name that only contains one (max_tokens, tokenCount) is not.

vectors.name: secret_member_name
vectors.about: A registered value used as a member name: the name is redacted as text, and the member keeps its value.

vectors.name: credential_shaped_member_name
vectors.about: A credential-shaped member name (a GitHub token) is redacted as text; its value is walked under the new name.

vectors.name: colliding_member_names
vectors.about: Two names that redact to the same text, and one already in the object: each later one gets a number, so that no member is lost.

vectors.name: pem_private_key
vectors.about: A PEM private key's body.
vectors.input:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEowIBAAKCAQEA
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

expect.output: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----[REDACTED]-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

vectors.name: aws_access_key_id
vectors.about: An AWS access key id.

vectors.name: github_token
vectors.about: A GitHub token.

vectors.name: github_token_alone
vectors.about: A GitHub token in prose.

vectors.name: slack_token
vectors.about: A Slack token.

vectors.name: sk_key
vectors.about: An sk- key in prose.

vectors.name: jwt
vectors.about: A JWT.

vectors.name: jwt_after_dash
vectors.about: A JWT starts at a word boundary: after `-` in a run of base64url characters, not after a letter.

vectors.name: pem_header_without_end
vectors.about: A PEM header with no end after it: nothing is replaced.

vectors.name: registered_value
vectors.about: A value the host registered, wherever it occurs.

vectors.name: registered_value_short_ignored
vectors.about: A registered value shorter than four characters is ignored.

vectors.name: no_false_positive_tokens_py
vectors.about: A file name that holds a credential name is not an assignment.

vectors.name: short_assignment_kept
vectors.about: An assignment of fewer than four characters is kept.

vectors.name: marker_kept
vectors.about: A value already redacted stays as it is, and is not reported again.

vectors.name: nested_json_pointers
vectors.about: Nested members are redacted and their pointers returned in document order, escaped as RFC 6901 says.

vectors.name: no_secret_json
vectors.about: A value without a secret is unchanged.

vectors.name: astral_value_counts_code_points
vectors.about: A credential value is counted in characters (code points): three, one of them outside the BMP, is too short.

vectors.name: non_ascii_letters_do_not_fold
vectors.about: Names match case-insensitively in ASCII only: a long s is not an s.

vectors.name: unicode_space_is_not_whitespace
vectors.about: Only ASCII whitespace separates a name from its value; another space is part of the value.

vectors.name: prefixed_assignment
vectors.about: An assignment to a longer name that ends in a credential name with no separator (PGPASSWORD): the refusal rule recognises it, so redaction does too.

vectors.name: secret_member_list
vectors.about: A secret member whose value is a list: each string in it is redacted.

vectors.name: secret_member_object
vectors.about: A secret member whose value is an object: each string in it is redacted, its names kept.

vectors.name: secret_member_number
vectors.about: A secret member whose value is a number (a PIN) is redacted whole.

vectors.name: structured_header_list
vectors.about: A header given as a list of values.

vectors.name: secret_member_flags_kept
vectors.about: Booleans and null in a secret member hold no secret and are kept, as is a string shorter than four characters.

vectors.name: har_header_pairs
vectors.about: Headers as name/value pairs (a HAR's request.headers): the value of a pair whose name is a secret member's is redacted whole; other headers stay.

vectors.name: pair_name_members
vectors.about: A pair's name may be its key or header member, in any case (Postman, AWS tags); its value member is redacted.

vectors.name: header_tuples
vectors.about: Headers as [name, value] tuples (fetch's entries, Python's http.client): the second element of a two-element array whose first is a secret member's name is redacted; other tuples stay.

vectors.name: har_cookies
vectors.about: A HAR's cookies member is a secret member: every string in it is redacted, a cookie's name included; its member names stay.

vectors.name: pair_in_text
vectors.about: A name/value pair in JSON or code text: the value after a secret member's name and a value label is redacted, after its scheme.

vectors.name: tuple_in_text
vectors.about: A [name, value] tuple in code text: the value after an opening bracket and a secret member's name is redacted.

vectors.name: anchor_excerpt_drops_digest
vectors.about: An anchor whose excerpt quotes a secret loses the digest of what it cites: the excerpt left around the marker would let a guess of the password be checked against the digest.

vectors.name: anchor_registered_secret_alone
vectors.about: A host's registered secret quoted whole: the digest, of the secret alone, goes with it.

vectors.name: anchor_ref_drops_metadata_hash
vectors.about: A secret in the ref: a content hash kept in the metadata goes too, and the other metadata stays.

vectors.name: anchor_metadata_secret_drops_digest
vectors.about: A secret in the metadata only: the anchor keeps no digest either.

vectors.name: anchor_secret_without_digest
vectors.about: An anchor with a secret and no digest: redacted, and nothing is said of a digest it never had.

vectors.name: anchor_without_secret_keeps_digest
vectors.about: An anchor with no secret keeps its digest.

vectors.name: url_userinfo_empty_user
vectors.about: The password of a URL's userinfo whose user's name is empty (Redis's form).

vectors.name: escaped_json_text
vectors.about: An assignment in JSON text inside a JSON string or a shell's double quotes: its quotes escaped.

vectors.name: escaped_json_text_twice
vectors.about: JSON text escaped twice; the escapes around the marker stay.

vectors.name: escaped_authorization_and_pair
vectors.about: An Authorization header and a header pair in escaped JSON text.

vectors.name: user_option
vectors.about: A command's user option: the password after the user's name (curl -u, --user, -U, --proxy-user).
vectors.input: curl -u admin:S3cr3tP4ss https://a.example.com; curl --user=ops:hunter22 -U proxy:Pr0xyPass99 https://b.example.com

expect.output: curl -u admin:[REDACTED] https://a.example.com; curl --user=ops:[REDACTED] -U proxy:[REDACTED] https://b.example.com

vectors.name: user_option_list_item
vectors.about: A user option and its value as items of a list, as an exception's text quotes a command.

vectors.name: credential_option
vectors.about: A command's option named for a credential, its value after blanks.

vectors.name: credential_option_before_an_option
vectors.about: An option named for a credential followed by another option: no value.

vectors.name: user_option_without_password
vectors.about: Options that take no user:password pair are kept.
vectors.input: git push -u origin main && sort -u names.txt

expect.output: git push -u origin main && sort -u names.txt

vectors.name: secret_key_and_passphrase
vectors.about: SECRET_KEY, secret_key and passphrase are credential names.

vectors.name: secret_key_members
vectors.about: Members named secret_key and passphrase are secret members.

vectors.name: registered_value_encoded
vectors.about: A registered value is replaced in the forms text carries it in: percent-encoded (upper- or lower-case hex) and JSON-escaped.

vectors.name: registered_value_non_ascii
vectors.about: A registered value with non-ASCII characters, escaped as \u in JSON text and percent-encoded as UTF-8.
